parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false in its flags but is structurally a sample-app file by directory convention (Examples/WallpaperSampleApp). More decisively, the decision rules treat any record under Examples/ as a sample-app-mirror restraint marker regardless of the flag value, making no-action the correct default. The other record lives in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' in the production 'DebugPanel' package. Merging or lifting the sample-app copy would couple production DebugPanel semantics to a demonstration context, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. Additionally, both records have empty fields_or_signature lists and no name populated, providing no structural evidence that a meaningful shared abstraction exists.
